items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Titled sections exist (h2 Personal details, Job and contract, Bank and tax information, Emergency contact, Documents) as a 6-step wizard, and every field has a label above it. But fields sit in a multi-column grid (div.grid.sm:grid-cols-6 with sm:col-span-2/3), so it is not a single column; the screenshot shows 2 to 3 fields per row.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required fields get a red asterisk via .req::after consistently. Optional fields (Preferred name, Gender, Alternate phone) are unmarked, but no legend or note states the convention. Only the document list says Required or Optional.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Types are right (type=email, type=tel, type=date). Widths are grid-driven, not content-driven: ZIP is sm:col-span-2 (one third, same as City), SSN is col-span-3 (half the row), Routing is a third, Hours per week is a third.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: Button #saveDraft in the page header. Its handler writes values to localStorage 'onb-draft' without calling validateStep/check, and shows 'Draft saved at ...'.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: The Back/Continue footer is a normal flex div (border-t px-6 py-4), not sticky or fixed. There is no Cancel button. Save draft sits in the page header and scrolls away. Primary label is 'Continue' or 'Submit onboarding' (verb, not disabled), but the sticky and Cancel parts are missing.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: Blur listener calls check() only when the field has a value, so empty required fields are not flagged on blur. validateStep focuses the first invalid field (first.focus()). The #banner shows only the plain text 'Please correct the highlighted fields before continuing.' with no list of errors and no links to fields.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: No beforeunload handler anywhere in the script.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Intro text 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each'. renderDocs lists file name and size with a Remove button (data-rm) and Replace/Upload. Inputs are native input[type=file].sr-only inside labels, so they are focusable. Oversize files are rejected with alert(). Caveat: there is no visible focus style on the label when the hidden input is focused.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: #doneMsg reads '${firstName} ${lastName} has been added as ...' (names the employee), but #done and #doneMsg have no role=status, role=alert or aria-live, and focus is not moved to it.

notes: Wizard (6 steps) rather than one sectioned form; side stepper plus 'Completion' progress card. Review step nests bordered group boxes inside the form card (card-in-card). Indigo accent on white/slate with no navy sidebar. The 'N' tile in the header is a logo mark, not a person avatar, so not counted. Automated audit score 90, with one contrast error (the '/' separator in the header, 1.48:1). Document step shows prefilled mock files; MOCK data is preloaded into the form. SSN input has a placeholder but also a label. Hover styles are background changes only (no lift).
